name: Global Leaderboards & Cloud Account Save Safety
greenMarker: Cloud Save, 2-Ad Hint Limit & No-Hint Safety Audit PASSED 100%
note: A backup that silently omits what it claims to save is worse than no backup, because the player trusts it and stops keeping their own copy. cloudSyncService once re-typed two of three storage keys wrong and reported success anyway.

mutations.name: the wallet key is re-typed as a literal instead of imported
mutations.why: This is the original defect verbatim. 'suidoku_wallet_state_v1' looks right in review; only the running app disagrees, and backup kept reporting success with the wallet missing from the payload.

mutations.name: achievements are read by a hand-written key
mutations.why: That key is 'sudoku_achievements_v1' — no 'i' — unlike every other key in the app. Anyone re-typing it from memory gets it wrong and reads nothing.

mutations.name: the backup payload loses its schema version
mutations.why: Without a version the restore side cannot tell an old payload from a new one, and a shape change silently corrupts whatever it reads back.

mutations.name: the two-ad hint limit per game is removed
mutations.why: The cap is the whole ad economy. Without it a player can watch ads until the puzzle solves itself, and the difficulty curve and the IQ metric both become meaningless.

mutations.name: hints become available in Time Attack
mutations.why: Speedrun records are only comparable if nobody had help. A hint button there quietly invalidates every leaderboard entry in that category.

mutations.name: a save uploads local progress over the cloud without merging
mutations.why: The shipped defect. Every win calls saveToCloud, and the snapshot is one slot per account. With one account on two phones the phone that won last erased the other's progress from the cloud; a freshly installed phone did it on its first win. Found with the same account signed in on two test phones on 2026-09-17.
mutations.expectFailure: A fresh phone's first win uploaded gamesWon 1 over the cloud's 90

mutations.name: a save writes to the cloud after failing to read it
mutations.why: Merging only protects the cloud if a failed read stops the write. A network error on the read looks exactly like an empty slot to code that only checks for data, and the upload then replaces whatever the other phone saved without ever seeing it.
mutations.expectFailure: saveToCloud wrote to the cloud after failing to read it

mutations.name: a merge keeps the slower best time
mutations.why: min and max are one character apart. The rule is shared by save and restore now, so getting it wrong would push the worse time into the cloud on every win and pull it onto every phone that restores.
mutations.expectFailure: the faster best time wins a level both sides have

mutations.name: the S+ grade achievement is unlocked only from the victory screen again
mutations.why: The victory screen now comes after the post-game ad. A player who closes the app during that ad would lose an achievement the win had already earned.
mutations.expectFailure: must unlock the S+ grade achievement inside handleGameWinLogic

mutations.name: the win no longer starts the cloud save
mutations.why: The save used to run from the victory screen. With the ad in front of it, the backup would depend on the player sitting through the ad.
mutations.expectFailure: The win must start the cloud save itself
